title: Li–Li undirected network coding
reason: Already added to the large-category second pass during this research; not counted twice.

title: Affine extractors with O(log n) entropy
reason: Li's 2023 construction reaches this entropy target.

title: The original exact Gotsman–Linial conjecture
reason: Counterexamples are known. Only the distinct asymptotic O(d sqrt(n)) version is retained.

title: The polylogarithmically weakened Gotsman–Linial bound
reason: Kane established the sqrt(n) times degree-dependent polylogarithmic bound.

title: The deterministic Nisan–Ronen conjecture
reason: The m-machine deterministic lower bound has been proved; existing TCS-4944 selects that problem.

title: Optimal approximate-DP continual counting
reason: July 2026 preprint claims the optimal dependence on stream length. Retain the distinct pure-DP maximum-error question.

title: Tightness of Marton's inner bound
reason: August 2026 preprint gives a counterexample. General broadcast-channel capacity remains the retained problem.

title: Deterministic NP-hardness of Euclidean SVP
reason: Already TCS-0651; an August 2026 preprint also claims deterministic hardness.

title: The coarse Pi2P-versus-PSPACE finite QCSP dichotomy
reason: FOCS 2025 lists a theorem with this dichotomy; do not repeat the older coarse question.

title: FPRAS for Eulerian orientations
reason: The known approximation algorithm for orientations must not be confused with the open Euler-TOUR counting problem.

title: Intrinsic universality of noncooperative tile assembly
reason: The noncooperative model is not intrinsically universal.

title: Directed two-dimensional temperature-1 tile-assembly universality
reason: The directed model has decidability/structural limitations; the old blanket universality question is unsafe to relist.

title: Full computational power of nondirected temperature-1 assembly
reason: No sufficiently precise, source-checked surviving formulation was established in this pass. Not used to fill Miscellaneous.
